title: Grace Apartments D8-09, Tatu City
address: Tatu City, Ruiru, Kiambu County, Kenya
description: A fully furnished two-bedroom apartment in Tatu City, Ruiru, available for short stays. The kitchen is fully fitted, with a dishwasher, washing machine and a breakfast bar for four. The living room is furnished, the main bedroom has an en suite bathroom, and the second bedroom has its own separate toilet and bathroom. A balcony looks out over the courtyard and a green park. Internet is included.
house_rules: Please book in advance so we can confirm availability and avoid conflicting reservations.

title: Githii Farm House
description:
Exclusive use of the entire four-bedroom farmhouse in Nyandarua, which sleeps 6–8 guests. The nightly rate includes fresh farm produce for breakfast, such as eggs, milk and seasonal vegetables, subject to availability.

Bedrooms and bathrooms
Four bedrooms with warm bedding, four en-suite bathrooms with hot showers, towels and toiletries, and electric blankets or hot water bottles.

Living and dining
A lounge with sofas, a dining table for 6–8 guests and an indoor fireplace or wood stove.

Self-catering kitchen
Cooker, fridge, microwave, kettle, toaster, cookware, crockery and cutlery for eight, drinking water and tea and coffee supplies.

Wi-Fi, entertainment and power
Wi-Fi, a smart TV with Netflix or DStv, backup power and a dedicated workspace.

Outdoor space
A garden with outdoor seating, a fire pit and BBQ grill, a veranda or balcony overlooking the Aberdares, secure parking and an on-site caretaker.

Farm experiences
Depending on the season, guests can tour the farm, watch milking, feed animals, pick strawberries or visit the vegetable garden.

Included in the nightly rate
Caretaker support, daily housekeeping, fresh linen, firewood and farm produce for breakfast.

Available at an extra charge
A private chef and guided outings in Nakuru and Nyandarua.
